mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over a 3-month period signals weakening economic activity, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 2% over 3 months but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.5% over a 3-month period signals a tightening monetary policy, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% over a 3-month period signals weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If UNRATE exceeds 5.5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Real Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) above 4% over a 3-month period signals strengthening economic activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: If RSAFS exceeds 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1,400 units over a 3-month period signals weakening construction activity, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced demand for building materials and related sectors.
failure_condition: If HOUST falls below 1,400 and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% over a 3-month period signals rising inflation, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about monetary tightening and reduced consumer purchasing power.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Employment Situation (PAYEMS) above 140,000 new jobs per month over a 3-month period signals strengthening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS exceeds 140,000 and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Gross Domestic Product (GDPC1) above 3% over a 3-month period signals strengthening economic activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 exceeds 3% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.
